Hold theFence

Gather by day. Hold the line by night.

  • ☀By day, chop trees for wood, apples and saplings. Spend wood and metal on defenses.
  • ☾By night, zombies come in waves. They drop bone dust and metal scraps.
  • ✚Stand next to a defense, the fence or your home to repair or upgrade it with bone dust.
  • ●Tap the apple to eat. Between waves, spend apples on boosts for the rest of the night.
